newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Former Adsteam group's IEL gets A$877 mln tax bill.
newsitem.headline: Former Adsteam group's IEL gets A$877 mln tax bill.

text.p: Members of the former Adelaide Steamship Co Ltd group - DJL Ltd, Tooth and Co Ltd and Residual Assco Group Ltd - on Wednesday disputed as "unrealistic" an A$877 million tax bill for the jointly owned Industrial Equity Ltd (IEL) group.

In statements to the stock exchange, the companies said that following protracted discussions with the Australian Taxation Office, IEL had received notices of assessment amounting in aggregate to A$876.92 million tax payable.
Of that amount which related to the years ending June 30 1992 and 1993 and was payable on July 30 1997, nearly A$400 million related to additional tax, penalties and interest, they said.
"Based on advice previously received, IEL directors believe the amount assessed is unrealistic," the statements said.
"IEL will be lodging objections to these notices of assessment," they said.
